system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Boyer-Moore majority vote algorithm. It instantiates the main majority vote specification with concrete parameters to enable exhaustive verification using a model checker: three distinct values and a bounded sequence length.
actors_and_components: The module defines three constant model values representing the distinct elements that can appear in sequences, and a bound parameter controlling the maximum sequence length. It instantiates the main majority vote specification with these concrete values.
state_variables: The state variables are inherited from the main majority vote specification: the input sequence, the current scan position, the candidate element, and the counter. Additionally, the module defines a bounded sequence operator that restricts sequences to those of length at most the specified bound.
initial_state: Inherited from the main specification: sequences are drawn from all sequences of up to the bounded length over the three-element value set, the scan position starts at one, the candidate is chosen nondeterministically, and the counter starts at zero.
actions: All actions are inherited from the main majority vote specification: scanning the next element with the three-case logic (adopt new candidate, increment counter, or decrement counter).
safety_properties: Inherited from the main specification: type correctness, the main correctness property (any true majority element must equal the candidate after a complete scan), and the inductive invariant.
liveness_properties: Inherited from the main specification: the scan eventually completes under weak fairness.
model_bounds: Three model values for the element set. The sequence length bound is set to 5 in the configuration. Sequences are restricted to all functions from one through n to the value set, for n ranging from zero to the bound.
additional_assumptions: The bound parameter is assumed to be a natural number. The module uses a bounded sequence construction rather than the standard sequence definition to keep the state space finite for model checking. Deadlock checking is disabled in the configuration.
